judged_text: EventManager.create crashes with a TypeError on empty/missing destinationCalendar because optional chaining was removed: destructuring `[]`/`null` yields `undefined` and the code reads `.integration` off it directly, so Google Meet bookings without a destination calendar (set to `null` in handleNewBooking.ts:1067 and `[]` in confirm.handler.ts:175, paypal-webhook.ts:152, webhook.ts:119) throw a 500 at booking create/confirm/payment-success instead of falling back to Cal Video.

adjudication.rationale: In `packages/core/EventManager.ts`, the diff changes the Google Meet fallback check to destructure the first element of `evt.destinationCalendar` (`const [mainHostDestinationCalendar] = evt.destinationCalendar ?? [];`) and then directly accesses `mainHostDestinationCalendar.integration` without optional chaining. When `destinationCalendar` is `null`, `undefined`, or an empty array (which the diff explicitly introduces in several places, e.g. `confirm.handler.ts` and `paypal-webhook.ts` set `destinationCalendar: []`, and `handleNewBooking.ts` can set it to `null`), `mainHostDestinationCalendar` is `undefined`, so `.integration` throws a `TypeError`, causing a 500 instead of falling back to Cal Video.
